svg.title: Transport and localization
svg.desc: Localized protocols: centered variance; D_eff (dimensionless); mean drift ⟨vₓ⟩ (dimensionless); tuned V-Theta diffusion coincidence with separate mean drift. Logarithmic rate axes in a-c and logarithmic variance in a; sampled rates and masses are labeled. Curves are exact. Symbols, when present, are S-074 post-result paired Richardson independent-trajectory estimates with one-standard-error bars. Parameters and scientific scope are in the caption.
